question:
Which of the given statements is/are correct with respect to NAFED?

i. NAFED is registered under the Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act.

ii. It was set up with the objective of promoting Cooperative marketing of agricultural produce to benefit farmers.

iii. It was established in 1958.
solution:
The correct answer is__** All**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NAFED:-**

 
 
• It stands for National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India Limited.
 
• NAFED is a cooperative society that is registered under the Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act.
 
• The objective behind the establishment of NAFED was to promote cooperative marketing of agricultural produce, which would benefit farmers.
 
• NAFED was established in 1958, and since then, it has been playing a crucial role in ensuring fair prices for farmers and promoting agricultural exports from India.
